caption: A car brakes hard on a dry road, its tyres screech and leave dark skid marks, and it stops within a short distance.

sa.check: A car brakes hard on a dry road.
Dark skid marks appear behind the tyres.
It stops within a short distance.
The braking comes first and the marks and stop follow.

pc.expect: The marks appear behind the tyres only while braking and stay after.
pc.fail: Marks appear ahead of the tyres; or before braking; or they vanish.

pc.expect: The car slows quickly and comes to rest on a straight line.
pc.fail: It slides on as if on ice; or swerves; or speeds up.
It restarts; or rolls back; or jumps.

pc.expect: The tyres may smoke and the car's nose dips.
pc.fail: The tyres deform hugely; or the car flips; or the body bends.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another vehicle.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the road stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the road markings shift; or the surroundings rearrange.
